patch.value: Workspace position read: one bounded answer to where this workspace stands in the branch-and-merge workflow and what to run next, replacing a protocol the agent must remember

Six surfaces answer fragments of one question and none answers it: pm merge install is correct exactly once per clone, pm merge reconcile and pm merge report are meaningful only while receipts are pending, pm history-repair is documented as the thing to run after a merge, pm validate --check-history-drift is only interpretable if you know a merge just happened, and pm health aggregates the pieces without sequencing them. The condition each one depends on is fully derivable from recorded state — driver configuration, pending receipts, drift counts, reanchor points in the history streams — yet the sequencing lives in transient merge-driver stdout and in a sentence in AGENTS.md that a fresh session does not have. A returning agent in a clone it did not prepare cannot ask pm where it is; it has to already know. This is the pm-kcs4 and pm-tqel lever applied to the family whose members are distinguished not by their noun but by which moment of the workflow they are correct in, and it is the concrete instance behind grammar ruling K on pm-pbyu. Measured on 2026.8.2: a fresh clone has zero merge drivers configured while carrying a committed .gitattributes that names five, and although pm health does name merge_driver_configuration_missing among its warnings, the check declares required:false and the workspace verdict stays ok:true with exit 0, so the one aggregate an agent is routed to reports a healthy workspace whose next merge will be resolved by git's line-based default.

A single bounded read reports whether the merge fence is active for this clone, whether receipts are pending, whether history drift is present, and which command is the next correct action, in a projection cheap enough for an agent loop; The read is derived entirely from recorded workspace and repository state, with no flag the caller must know to pass and no dependence on output from an earlier command in the session; A clone whose committed merge fence names drivers that are not configured is reported as an unprepared workspace by the aggregate health verdict, not only as a warning line beneath ok:true; Every existing surface in the family keeps its current behaviour and spelling; the new read composes them rather than replacing them, and the noun-verb table records each of them as state-conditional with its condition named
Removes a remembered protocol from the agent's cold-start cost and makes the most dangerous unprepared state self-reporting.
Every fresh clone, worktree and CI checkout is currently one unrun command away from line-merging tracker data, and the aggregate health read says ok.
One bounded read reports combination state and the next correct action; the six existing surfaces keep working and become its implementation.
Ruling K makes state-conditional verbs without a detectable condition non-conforming, and the grammar conformance gate needs the conforming shape to exist first.

author: harness:claude-code
message: Wire the workspace position read into the grammar spine
